value.answer: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot, featuring substantial improvements in coding, web development, and knowledge work. It outperforms its predecessor, Gemini 3.6 Flash, in processing complex documents and generating functional layouts and feature-complete apps in fewer prompts. The model is also better at coding tasks like debugging and issue resolution.
